description: Header file defining APIs and constants for handling JSON requests in Host Interface component, including function declarations for starting/stopping HTTP server, handling JSON messages, and parsing/creating JSON data.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStart
methods.description: Starts the HTTP server for handling JSON requests.

methods.name: hostIf_HTTPJsonMsgHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming JSON messages from HTTP clients.

methods.name: hostIf_HttpServerStop
methods.description: Stops the HTTP server handling JSON requests.
